page.title: Your meals
page.purpose: Keep the person's own meals findable and plannable: a photo collection with search, filters, favourites, drafts, and a Plan action on every card, plus Add meal and Import recipe for capturing as little or as much detail as they have.

priorities.statement: Saved meals appear as recognisable cards — image, name, active time, and at most two evidence-backed tags — each with a one-tap Plan.
Add meal accepts just a name and saves a draft; nothing else is required.
Search, chips, and Filters narrow the collection, and the filter state survives navigating away and back.
Counts distinguish total saved meals from filtered results, and drafts stay easy to find.
A meal that does not fit current rules stays in the collection with its reason instead of disappearing.
Explore is one tab away for new ideas that fit.

states.description: The saved collection as a photo grid on wide screens and a one-column feed on phones.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
No meals are saved yet; Add a meal and Explore are offered.
A search or filter matched nothing; the query stays visible and Reset filters is offered.
The Drafts filter lists name-only and incomplete meals with Add details.
Add meal is open with a name or rough-text field; a name alone saves a draft.
A pasted or file import is staged for review, showing unknown quantities, duplicates, and assumptions before anything is saved.
Some cards have no image; they render a deliberate no-photo treatment of the same size.
Some saved meals do not fit the current rules; they stay visible with the reason and without a fitting claim.

claims.statement: Add meal is the one filled primary action; Import recipe is secondary.
A name alone saves a durable draft, and blank numbers stay unknown instead of becoming zero.
Quick meals and High protein tags appear only when their policy has evidence; a name or image never earns a badge.
The favourite control names the meal and whether it is a favourite, and is distinct from the Explore bookmark.
The meal link, favourite, and Plan are separately keyboard reachable, with no button nested inside another interactive control.
An empty search or filter result offers Reset filters.
The count distinguishes saved meals from filtered results.
A card without an image keeps its size and actions and looks deliberate.
A meal outside the current rules stays in the collection with its reason.
On phones the collection is one readable card per row, never minuscule two-column food cards.
Filter chips scroll within their row and the page never scrolls sideways.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
